description: List briefs. DEFAULT shows human-authored briefs only; kind:"clip" shows the machine-minted clip briefs (suggest_briefs output), kind:"all" shows everything. Each carries its quote.

after.description: Opaque cursor from the previous page's `pagination.nextCursor`. Forward-only.

kind.description: Which briefs to list. `authored` (default) = human-authored only; `clip` = the machine-minted clip briefs from suggest_briefs; `all` = both.

limit.description: Page size (1..100), default 20. Out-of-range or unparseable clamps into the range.

projectId.description: Scope to one project. Omit for every brief in the org.

name: list_briefs
title: List Briefs
